scripts.text:
[Mungmung]
I'm not the innkeeper!
Why do people want to pay me when they see me?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我不是旅店老板！
为什么一看到我，大家就想付钱给我？

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
My pain is getting worse and worse
since the crevice appeared in Bifrost.
Are you responsible for it, young one?
scripts.translation:
[内姆内姆]
自从彩虹桥出现裂缝以来，我的病痛越来越严重了。
是你干的吗，年轻人？

scripts.text: Of course I am!
scripts.translation: 当然是我！

scripts.text: That's an unfair accusation!
scripts.translation: 这是冤枉人！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
Bra~vo!
scripts.translation:
[内姆内姆]
好~样的！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
If not, never mind!
scripts.translation:
[内姆内姆]
如果不是，那就当我没说！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation
was at its worst.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以当时的情况已经糟糕到了极点。

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh~!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔斯]
噢~！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
Bored to death, I started to cry.
Then I fell asleep, tired from all the crying.
And when I woke up,
I was even more bored
than before!
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
我无聊得要死，就哭了起来。
然后哭累了，就睡着了。
等我醒来的时候，比之前还要无聊！

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh, oh!
That's terrible, so terrible.
How could that happen?!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔斯]
噢，噢！
太可怕了，太可怕了。
怎么会发生这种事？！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation got
more and more serious...
Now give me some more coins.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以情况变得越来越严重...
好了，再给我几枚硬币吧。

scripts.text:
[Rangrang]
I've never heard such a boring and sad story.
I feel like crying!
scripts.translation:
[朗朗]
我从没听过这么无聊又悲伤的故事。
我都想哭了！

scripts.text:
[A Decoy]
Oh~!
That's just so
unbelievable!
I'm so curious, let's give him some coins!
scripts.translation:
[诱饵]
噢~！
这简直太不可思议了！
我好想知道后面怎么样，我们再给他几枚硬币吧！

scripts.text:
[Moved Raffle]
This is sad, too sad!
I'm not sure why,
but it must be sad
because everybody else says so.
scripts.translation:
[感动的 拉弗尔]
这太悲伤了，太悲伤了！
虽然我也不知道为什么，但大家都这么说，那一定很悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Wow~!
This is exciting.
He woke up safe and sound again!
Well, I'm sure he will next time!
...
scripts.translation:
[松了口气的 拉弗尔]
哇~！
真刺激。
他又平安醒来了！
嗯，下次他一定也会的！
...

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[松了口气的 拉弗尔]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Excited Raffle]
Wow~
The story is no fun at all.
Wow~!
But it's as if we were singing in chorus -
it's really fun.
Wow~!
scripts.translation:
[兴奋的 拉弗尔]
哇~
这个故事一点都不好玩。
哇~！
不过就像大家一起合唱一样——真的很好玩。
哇~！

scripts.text:
[Impressed Raffle]
Wow! Wow!
scripts.translation:
[佩服的 拉弗尔]
哇！哇！

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
I'm stuck here because of the crevice, which appeared out of nowhere.
Ha......
scripts.translation:
[穆拉的访客]
因为突然出现的裂缝，我被困在这里了。
唉......

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
Isn't this one cheerful village?
With Bifrost blocked like that, I'm thinking of settling here permanently.
scripts.translation:
[穆拉的访客]
这村子真是热闹快乐，不是吗？
既然彩虹桥都堵成那样了，我正考虑在这里定居下来。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I heard that somebody made it out of the Labyrinth Forest alive.
Whoever it is, I want to meet this person myself.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
听说有人活着走出了迷藏森林。
不管是谁，我都想亲眼见见。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷藏森林，成为英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我听说已经有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我说那个人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
算了吧。说是我做到的还更可信一点。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，确实是这样。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷藏森林，成为英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我听说已经有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我说那个人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
算了吧。说是我做到的还更可信一点。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，确实是这样。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Stay clear of the Labyrinth Forest.
Don't ever dream of peeking in out of curiosity.
Lots of travelers have gone missing after going there.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
离迷藏森林远一点。
千万别因为好奇就想进去看看。
很多旅行者进去之后就失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
The public bath in the center of the village is a symbol of Mora Village.
scripts.translation:
[悠闲的大王花]
村子中央的公共浴池是穆拉村的象征。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
It's not just a simple puddle.
It has tremendous power
to heal wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠闲的大王花]
它可不只是一滩水。
它拥有治愈伤口的强大力量。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
Try walking in the bath
if you want to see for yourself.
It will slowly but surely heal your wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠闲的大王花]
如果你想亲自体验，不妨走进浴池试试。
它会慢慢地、确实地治好你的伤。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I want to climb the ladder,
but my legs are too short to do that.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗尔]
我想爬梯子，可是我的腿太短，爬不上去。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I wonder who brought it here.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗尔]
不知道是谁把梯子搬到这里来的。

scripts.text:
You see a Rafflesia
lost in reading.
scripts.translation: 你看到一朵大王花正沉浸在阅读中。

scripts.text: See what he's reading.
scripts.translation: 看看它在读什么

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 别打扰它

scripts.text:
Curious about what he's reading,
you quietly approach him from behind.
The Rafflesia is reading in a low voice.
scripts.translation:
你好奇它在读什么，悄悄从背后靠近。
大王花正在低声朗读。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren was going to Eremes's.
He was going there to borrow
Eremes's reference books,
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞伦要去艾勒梅斯家。
他是去借艾勒梅斯的参考书的，

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
but he also hoped to see
his beautiful sister, Seiren.
Seiren knocked on Eremes's door
with his heart pounding.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
但他也希望能见到艾勒梅斯美丽的妹妹。
塞伦怀着怦怦直跳的心敲响了艾勒梅斯家的门。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
Excuse me. Is anybody there?
... ... ...
He doesn't hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
咚！咚！咚！
打扰了。有人在家吗？
... ... ...
他什么也没听到。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Is there nobody home?
He knocked again,
afraid that he might have
made the trip for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
难道没人在家？
他担心自己白跑一趟，又敲了一次门。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
No answer again. Is there nobody home?
He knew it was rude to do that,
but he decided to enter anyway
and wait for Eremes to come back home.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
咚！咚！咚！
还是没人应声。难道没人在家？
他知道这样很失礼，但还是决定进屋等艾勒梅斯回来。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren opened the front door
with his heart throbbing.
*squeak*
The door wasn't locked.
Eremes seems to be away for a while.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞伦怀着怦怦直跳的心打开了前门。
*吱呀*
门没有锁。
看来艾勒梅斯出去一阵子了。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren entered the house hesitantly.
The moment he stepped into the house,
he heard a sound of water running.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞伦犹犹豫豫地走进屋里。
刚踏进屋内，他就听到了流水声。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren suddenly came to his senses,
and turned back to go out.
But right at the moment!!
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
塞伦突然回过神来，转身想要出去。
但就在这一瞬间！！

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*thud*
The bathroom door opened,
and with white steam pouring out came a foot.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
*咔嗒*
浴室的门开了，一只脚伴随着涌出的白色蒸汽迈了出来。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren's heart almost stopped
at the sight of it. And a moment later,
somebody came out from the bathroom,
with just a towel around her body.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
看到这一幕，塞伦的心脏几乎停止了跳动。片刻之后，一个只裹着一条浴巾的人从浴室里走了出来。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
With her body still wet
from the shower...
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
她的身体还带着刚洗完澡的水珠...

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*gasp* Who are you? How long
were you standing there? How rude.
scripts.translation:
[读书的大王花]
*倒吸一口气* 你是谁？你在那里站了多久？太没礼貌了。

scripts.text:
The Rafflesia closed the book hastily.
You're curious what will happen next,
but you've been rude enough,
so you just give up.
scripts.translation:
大王花慌忙合上了书。
你很好奇接下来会发生什么，但你已经够失礼了，只好作罢。

scripts.text:
You leave the place quietly
in order not to disturb
the Rafflesia, who was lost in reading.
scripts.translation:
为了不打扰沉浸在阅读中的大王花，
你悄悄地离开了这里。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
You want a banana?
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
你想要香蕉吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 好，我要

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Take it if you can.
If you are successful, you can have it for free.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
有本事就来拿吧。
如果拿到了，就免费送你。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Well, I was going to give it for free,
but if you don't want it, it's fine with me.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
嗯，我本来打算免费送你的，
不过你不要的话也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Mora Inn is famous
for its unusual pieces of furniture.
Mushroom closets and apple dressers...
Aren't they so innovative?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉旅馆以独特的家具而闻名。
蘑菇衣柜、苹果梳妆台...
是不是很有创意？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Sorry... maybe it's just me...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
抱歉...也许只有我这么觉得...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Rafflesia in Mora Village all look alike, so it's so confusing.
It's like looking at centuplets...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉村的大王花长得都一个样，真让人分不清。
就像在看百胞胎一样...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
However! If you look closely,
you'll find each of them has a personality.
To find it is one of the fun things
you can do in the village.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不过！只要仔细观察，你就会发现它们每个都有自己的个性。
找出这些个性，也是在村里的乐趣之一。

scripts.text:
[Wounded Raffle]
Ugghh... What was it
that was in the bath... Arrrghh...
To attack suddenly like that... Be careful...
Whatever it is in there, it's very aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[受伤的 拉弗尔]
呜呃...浴池里的那个到底是什么...啊啊...
居然突然袭击...要小心...
不管里面是什么，都非常凶猛。

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The inn over there~
It should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
那边的旅馆~
本该是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The store over there~
It should've been mine as well~
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
那边的商店~
也本该是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The warehouse here~
and all the things in it~
All of those should've been mine~
All of those should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
这里的仓库~
还有里面所有的东西~
全都本该是我的~
全都本该是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
Ahhh... I'd like to make money...
scripts.translation:
[活泼]
啊...我想赚点钱...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Oh... this duck...
scripts.translation:
[库奥里塔]
噢...这只鸭子...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Its slender red beak...
and the blush on its cheeks...
and its wings, ready to take off
any moment...
scripts.translation:
[库奥里塔]
它细长的红色鸟喙...
脸颊上的红晕...
还有随时准备起飞的翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
I want to have it badly...
What would happen if I stole it?
scripts.translation:
[库奥里塔]
我真的很想要它...
如果我把它偷走会怎样？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
With a little token of appreciation, I will tell you a quote that will help you in your life.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
只要给我一点谢礼，我就送你一句对人生有帮助的名言。

scripts.text: Give him a token of appreciation.
scripts.translation: 给他一点谢礼

scripts.text: Can't you just tell me?
scripts.translation: 不能直接告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You don't get something for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
天下没有免费的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
How much are you willing to give me?
You can pay me in the currencies listed below.
Enter the sum you're willing to pay. Enter 0 if you don't want to pay anything.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
你愿意付多少钱？
你可以用下面列出的货币支付。
请输入你愿意支付的金额。如果不愿支付，请输入0。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you don't want to hear a quote, eh?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
这么说，你不想听名言了？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You can pay between ^FF0000100 and 1000000^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
你可以支付^FF0000100到1000000^000000之间的金额。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think this is what my time is worth?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
你觉得我的时间就值这么点？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
The quote I'm going to tell you is...
Let's see... Wait a second.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
我要告诉你的名言是...
让我想想...稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
Okay! I think this is the one for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
好了！我觉得这句最适合你。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Nothing is more difficult,
and therefore more precious,
than to be able to decide.
- Napoleon Bonaparte -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
没有什么比做决定更难，因此也没有什么比做决定更珍贵。
- 拿破仑·波拿巴 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Sometimes we stare so long at a door that is closing,
that we see too late the one that is open.
- Alexander Graham Bell -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
我们常常盯着正在关上的门看太久，以至于太晚才发现另一扇已经打开的门。
- 亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
If it's that painful, why do you keep doing it?
The answer's simple.
Because it makes my heart beat,
because it excites me.
My body might suffer, but I'm a lot happier
doing what I have always wanted to do.
- Biya Han -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
既然那么辛苦，为什么还要继续？
答案很简单。
因为它让我心跳加速，因为它让我兴奋。
身体也许会受苦，但做自己一直想做的事，让我快乐得多。
- 韩飞野 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
You cannot persuade anybody
before you change yourself.
- Cheoljong Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
在改变自己之前，你无法说服任何人。
- 高哲宗 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Never regret what you have chosen.
- Miyoung Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
不要后悔你所做出的选择。
- 高美英 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
A man is not finished when he is defeated.
He is finished when he quits.
- Richard Nixon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
人被打败时并没有完蛋，放弃时才真正完蛋。
- 理查德·尼克松 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Failure is instructive.
The person who really thinks
learns quite as much from his failures
as from his successes.
- John Dewey -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
失败是有教育意义的。
真正善于思考的人，从失败中学到的和从成功中学到的一样多。
- 约翰·杜威 -

[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
我们播种思想，收获行动；
我们播种行动，收获习惯；
我们播种习惯，收获性格；
我们播种性格，收获命运。
- 伊拉斯谟 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
There is no greater folly
in the world
than for a man to despair.
- Miguel de Cervantes -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
世上没有比绝望更愚蠢的事了。
- 米格尔·德·塞万提斯 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Humility is the most difficult

对于那种必须经过解释才能被理解的美，我没有多少耐心。
如果它确实需要额外的诠释，我就会怀疑它是否达到了它的目的。
- 查理·卓别林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Life is a tragedy
when seen in close-up,
but a comedy
in long-shot.
- Charlie Chaplin -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
人生近看是悲剧，远看是喜剧。
- 查理·卓别林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The clearest sign of wisdom is continued cheerfulness.
- Michel de Montaigne -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
智慧最明显的标志是持续的愉悦。
- 米歇尔·德·蒙田 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The time you enjoyed wasting
was not wasted.
- John Lennon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
你乐在其中的浪费时光，并不是浪费。
- 约翰·列侬 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
True humor springs not more from the head than from the heart.
It is not contempt; its essence is love.
It issues not in laughter,
but in still smiles, which lie far deeper.
- Thomas Carlyle -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
真正的幽默与其说源于头脑，不如说源于心灵。
它不是轻蔑，其本质是爱。
它不表现为大笑，而是表现为更深沉的静静微笑。
- 托马斯·卡莱尔 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Through humor, you can soften
some of the worst blows
that life delivers.
And once you find laughter,
no matter how painful
your situation might be,
you can survive it.
- Bill Cosby -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
通过幽默，你可以减轻人生中一些最沉重的打击。
一旦你找到了笑声，无论处境多么痛苦，你都能熬过去。
- 比尔·科斯比 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
My great hope is to laugh
as much as I cry;
to get my work done
and try to love somebody
and have the courage
to accept the love in return.
- Maya Angelou -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
{0}，我要告诉你的名言是...
我最大的希望是笑得和哭得一样多；完成我的工作，试着去爱一个人，并有勇气接受对方的爱。
- 玛雅·安吉洛 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
People take what they hear
differently.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
每个人对听到的话都有不同的理解。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
I wonder what you think
about what I've told you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
不知道你对我说的话有什么看法。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think that {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
所以你认为{0}。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
... ... ... ...

[Raffle Philosopher]
I don't know. There is no one answer
to this question...
Hold onto your thought.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔哲人]
我也不知道。这个问题没有唯一的答案...
坚持你的想法吧。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you dare play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
你...你竟敢跟我玩这种把戏？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
What...? Do you have proof?
Do you have proof?!!
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
什...什么？你有证据吗？
你有证据吗？！！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Look, stop it, just stop it!
I'm afraid it will turn into a big fight...
scripts.translation:
[劝架的旅行者]
喂，别吵了，快停下！
我怕这会演变成一场大斗殴...

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Oh! Why don't we ask
that person there...?
scripts.translation:
[劝架的旅行者]
噢！我们要不问问那边那个人...？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
Oh, yes! That's a great idea.
Well~ Hello there~
You there, traveler!
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
噢，对！这是个好主意。
嘿~你好呀~
那边那位，旅行者！

scripts.text: They seem to be calling out to you.
scripts.translation: 他们好像在叫你。

scripts.text: See what the matter is.
scripts.translation: 看看发生了什么事

scripts.text: I have nothing to do with it.
scripts.translation: 与我无关

scripts.text:
You went on your way
leaving the travelers behind you.
scripts.translation: 你丢下那些旅行者，继续赶路了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's happening here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
I'll tell you what.
Rose's mother had 10 sons.
The eldest son is called Roseone,
the second Rosetwo,
the third Rosethree...
the ninth Rosenine...
you get how it works, right?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
我跟你说。
萝丝的妈妈有10个儿子。
老大叫萝丝一，老二叫萝丝二，老三叫萝丝三...老九叫萝丝九...
你明白规律了吧？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
Right, that's how it works.
So I asked what the youngest one would be called,
and when I told him the answer,
he got all upset and started cursing me.
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
对，就是这个规律。
所以我问他最小的儿子叫什么，我告诉他答案后，他就气得骂起我来了。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you bastard!
Hey there, what do you think
the answer to the question is?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
你...你这个混蛋！
喂，你说这个问题的答案是什么？

scripts.text: Roseten.
scripts.translation: 萝丝十

scripts.text: Rose.
scripts.translation: 萝丝

scripts.text: How would I know that?
scripts.translation: 我怎么知道？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Roseten.
Why are you fighting over such a trivial matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
答案是萝丝十。
你们怎么为这点小事吵起来了？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
See? Even this traveler says
Roseten is the answer.
How dare you try to play tricks on me?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
看吧？连这位旅行者都说答案是萝丝十。
你竟敢耍我？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
You idiot... you don't have the slightest clue!
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
你这个笨蛋...你根本什么都不懂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Rose.
You said Rose's mother had 10 sons.
So even if the other sons' names are
Roseone, Rosetwo, ... Rosenine,
the youngest one must be Rose,
or she wouldn't be called Rose's mother.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
答案是萝丝。
你说萝丝的妈妈有10个儿子。
所以就算其他儿子叫萝丝一、萝丝二...萝丝九，最小的那个也一定叫萝丝，不然她就不会被叫作萝丝的妈妈了。

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
That's exactly what I mean!
I can't hang around with him.
I guess we live in two different worlds.
scripts.translation:
[提问的旅行者]
我就是这个意思！
我跟他没法相处。
看来我们根本不是一个世界的人。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You bastard... What did you
get from this guy...?
scripts.translation:
[心烦的旅行者]
你这混蛋...你从这家伙那里拿了什么好处...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have no idea.
Try to sort it out yourselves.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也不知道。
你们自己解决吧。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
You good-for-nothing bastard,
you're trying to leave this mess to me?
scripts.translation:
[劝架的旅行者]
你这个没用的混蛋，想把这烂摊子丢给我？

scripts.text:
*thud*
You feel a sudden impact on the back of your head.
Your sight is going blurry.
scripts.translation:
*砰*
你感到后脑勺突然挨了一下。
你的视线渐渐模糊。

scripts.text: You feel somebody rummaging through your pockets before you pass out.
scripts.translation: 在失去意识之前，你感觉到有人在翻你的口袋。

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew~ Phew~
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼~ 呼~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snore...
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼噜...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼噜--

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼噜--

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Moan...
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew phew pheeew~
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼~ 呼~ 呼~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
z Z

[Mora Villager]
z Z

[穆拉村民]
z Z

[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
z Z

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh~ looks like we have another adventurer.
Where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哦~看来又来了一位冒险者。
您是从哪里来的？

scripts.text: Just save the game.
scripts.translation: 只要存档

scripts.text: I'd like to get some rest.
scripts.translation: 我想休息一下

scripts.text: The place I used to live is called...
scripts.translation: 我以前住的地方叫...

scripts.text: How can I use the warehouse?
scripts.translation: 如何使用仓库？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Wow, what's the rush?
You've just come here, and you're already going someplace else?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哇，这么着急？
你才刚来，就要去别的地方了？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
You know, haste makes waste. Tsk tsk.
Well, the game's been saved.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
俗话说，欲速则不达。啧啧。
好了，已经帮你存档了。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
My my, I need some rest also.
The rate is 5000 zeny. Do you want a room?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哎呀，我也需要休息一下。
房费是5000 Zeny。要住一间吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
The rate is 5000z.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
房费是5000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
请把这里当自己家吧。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
If you don't have the money, go soak yourself in the puddle in the center of the village.
It will warm you up.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
没钱的话，就去村子中央的水池里泡一泡吧。
那样也能暖和起来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I come from a place called {1}.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来自一个叫{1}的地方。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh, I think I've heard about the place before!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
哦，我好像听说过那个地方！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard there's an old tower where horrible witches put Savages in a giant cauldron and cast evil spells on them, right?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
听说那里有一座古老的塔，可怕的女巫们把野猪丢进巨大的锅里，对它们施加邪恶的咒语，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
What's worse is that whoever takes medicine made out of Savages will come back for more!
And he will wander around looking for the tower, and eventually turn into an enormous Savage!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
更可怕的是，吃了用野猪做的药的人，还会想再吃！
他会四处游荡寻找那座塔，最后变成一头巨大的野猪！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard that there are creeps there who won't get up at all even if it rains or snows, or their sweethearts or parents call them!
And that black clouds hover over them all the time, causing a storm!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
我还听说那里有些怪人，不管下雨下雪，还是恋人或父母叫他们，都怎么也不肯起床！
而且他们头上总是笼罩着乌云，还会引发暴风雨！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
How terrible!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Search through the vegetable-shaped drawer to my right.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
去翻翻我右边那个蔬菜形状的抽屉吧。

scripts.text: - You don't remember how to open the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你不记得怎么打开仓库了。-

scripts.text: - The figure 1 0 0 is written in small letters on the vegetable-shaped drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 蔬菜形状的抽屉上用小字写着数字 1 0 0。-

scripts.text: Insert 100 zeny.
scripts.translation: 投入100 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't do anything.
scripts.translation: 什么都不做

scripts.text: - You don't seem to have 100 zeny with you. -
scripts.translation: - 你身上好像没有100 Zeny。-

scripts.text: - You gave up using the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你放弃了使用仓库。-
